performance.verdict: Organic collapse and 5 overdue SOW milestones dwarf the zero-spend signal.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue: dashboard (Aug 31), scoreboard trust (Aug 31), contact cleanup (Aug 14), phone-match attribution (Aug 7), and renewal accountability (Jul 23) — all unresolved.
Zero paid spend and zero leads recorded across all 28 days — CPL is undefined; no paid channel is working because none is active.
Search Console clicks collapsed 70.83% week-over-week (last 3 days: 1, 0 — prior 3: 2, 0, 1); 28-day total only 61 clicks on 7,818 impressions — severe organic visibility loss.
GBP actions fell 40% week-over-week; last 3 days registered 0, 0, 0 actions vs prior 3-day average of ~6.3 — local presence signal has gone dark.
GHL shows 104 opportunities created (28d) but 0 won and 0 appointments — pipeline is filling but conversion to chair is untracked or broken; intake leak cannot be ruled out.

suggestions.text: Audit and restore GBP listing immediately — 3 consecutive zero-action days on a prove-it month is a critical local signal loss.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for 3 straight days (Sep 1–3) after a 40% week-over-week decline, on the same month the client's renewal is at stake. Nacer/SEO team must verify GBP listing status, check for suspensions or info changes, and restore any missing content or categories. Success check: GBP actions return to ≥5/day within 7 days (by 2026-09-10).

suggestions.text: Close dashboard and attribution milestones overdue since Aug 31 — renewal decision is blocked without a trusted scoreboard.
suggestions.monday_update: The client's stay/walk renewal decision depends on a live dashboard showing leads through to patients in the chair — this milestone was due Aug 31 and is undelivered. The pipeline shows 104 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments logged, meaning the scoreboard is unreadable. Ahmed/Ali must ship the dashboard and phone-match attribution fix this week. Success check: dashboard live and verified by Sohib with Lily by 2026-09-10.

suggestions.text: Hold all paid spend decisions until organic collapse cause is confirmed; re-check Search Console and GBP in 3 days.
